topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can't stop thinking about our conversation. Maybe I should have been more understanding, or at least given you a chance to remember. It's been so long, I guess it's only natural that some things, some people, might fade. I keep replaying those times we spent together, wondering if they meant as much to you as they did to me. I should have been more patient, realized that life gets busy, and memories can blur. I hope you know that despite everything, I still care deeply and would love to catch up and maybe make some new memories.
